description: An import projecting a last-wins locale slot gives the imported invocation the caller's value only: the imported document's first node is a stamp, which reads en-gb — a value it can only have through the projection — before the imported document sets its own locale to sv-se, which the slot's declared last-wins policy lets replace the projected value, and the caller's later stamp still reads en-gb, proving the imported context is a projection whose mutations never escape (under the reject default that second value is KDLITH-CTX006, invalid/data/slot-duplicate-reject)
